current_difficulty_reason: The standard Nikulin/K3 and quadric facts do not identify a dominant rational parameter space for the genus21 marked surface family. The authors reconstruct the three-quadric net from an elliptic pencil and bisecants, force its fourth exceptional curve, and then use an irreducible rational pencil member to produce the rational parameterization. Their explicit boundary deformation interchanges the two distinguished lattice classes and closes marked-cover irreducibility, supplying the new geometric obligation beyond the cited surface and compactification foundations.
